description: Prepare a deposit into a Morpho vault. Checks on-chain allowance and returns a ready-to-sign transactions array with approval txs (if needed) followed by the deposit tx. Handles USDT reset-to-zero and DAI non-standard approval.

amount.description: Token amount in human-readable decimals (e.g., "1000.50"), or "max" for full balance
